Content.zh:
大家好！

今天我们添加了一个新的bug反馈系统。
这应该可以帮助我们收集到更多的bug并更快地修复它们。
对于无法访问discord或steam论坛的玩家来说，这会是很好的帮助。
您可以从游戏内菜单或按F2打开bug反馈表单！

以下是更新日志的具体内容：

[h2]版本EA_0.19：[/h2]

- 添加了bug反馈表单。
- 现在可以切换鸡蛋堆叠的开/关状态。
- 修复了一个导致从水浸林地出发会到另一个水浸林地的问题。
- 将所有类型的虫子添加到了食物过滤器中。
- 修复了一个影响灰山鹑肉保质期的bug。


目前就这些。
下个公告见！
Content.en:
Hello everyone!

Today we've added a new bug report system. 
This should help us get more of your bugs and fix them faster. 
And should especially help with bugs from people that have no access to discord or the steam forums.
You can access the bug report form from the in-game menu or by pressing F2!

And here are the patch notes:

<size=150%>Version EA_0.19</size>

- Added the bug report form.
- Eggs stacks are toggleable now.
- Fixed a bug that was making you travel from the flooded grove to the flooded grove.
- Added all bugs to the food filter.
- Fixed a bug with partridge meat durability.


That's all for now.
See you on the next announcement!
